```{r}
#| label: setup
source(here::here("R/packages.R"))
source(here::here("R/functions.R"))

conflicted::conflict_prefer("filter", "dplyr")

# Load targets
tar_load(
  c(
    ppg,
    # FIXME: this is a temporary work-around until rhakhis updates
    si_table_name_update
  ),
  store = here::here("_targets")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-taxa
#| tbl-cap: "Synonymy in PPG II. Accepted names indicated with a dash (-). Species and below not included."
#| echo: false

# FIXME: this is a temporary work-around until rhakhis updates
si_table_name_update_filtered <-
  si_table_name_update |>
  filter_out(
    str_detect(response, "no change|already corrected")
  ) |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    ipni,
    names = c("scientificName", "scientificNameAuthorship"),
    delim = " ",
    too_many = "merge") |>
  select(-response)

ppg |>
  dplyr::filter_out(
    taxonRank %in% c(
      "form",
      "lusus",
      "prole",
      "species",
      "subspecies",
      "subform",
      "subvariety",
      "unranked",
      "variety"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    scientificName,
    scientificNameAuthorship,
    taxonRank,
    taxonomicStatus,
    acceptedNameUsageID
  ) |>
  # FIXME: this is a temporary work-around until rhakhis updates
  mutate(
    name_original = paste(scientificName, scientificNameAuthorship)
  ) |>
  verify(all(si_table_name_update_filtered$name_original %in% name_original)) |>
  rows_update(
    si_table_name_update_filtered,
    by = "name_original"
  ) |>
  select(-name_original) |>
  # END FIX
  left_join(
    select(
      ppg,
      acceptedNameUsageID = taxonID,
      accepted_sci_name = scientificName,
      accepted_sci_auth = scientificNameAuthorship,
      accepted_rank = taxonRank
    ),
    by = join_by(acceptedNameUsageID)
  ) |>
  arrange(scientificName) |>
  select(-acceptedNameUsageID) |>
  mutate(
    scientificName = case_when(
      taxonRank == "genus" ~ italicize_gen(scientificName),
      taxonRank == "subgenus" ~ italicize_subgen(scientificName),
      .default = scientificName
    ),
    accepted_sci_name = case_when(
      accepted_rank == "genus" ~ italicize_gen(accepted_sci_name),
      accepted_rank == "subgenus" ~ italicize_subgen(accepted_sci_name),
      .default = accepted_sci_name
    ),
    name = paste(scientificName, scientificNameAuthorship),
    acc_name = paste(accepted_sci_name, accepted_sci_auth) |>
      replace_na("-"),
    acc_name = case_when(
      taxonomicStatus == "accepted" ~ "-",
      .default = acc_name
    )
  ) |>
  filter(name != acc_name) |>
  select(
    Name = name,
    `Accepted name` = acc_name
  ) |>
  unique() |>
  assert(is_uniq, Name) |>
  assert(not_na, c(Name, `Accepted name`)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
